name: Dual Contouring 2D
definition: A technique to generate a 2D mesh (vertices and edges) from a scalar field function by constructing a dual contour within a grid cell based on interpolated intersection points and surface normals.
summary: Dual Contouring 2D extracts 2D polygonal meshes from scalar fields by placing single vertices in grid cells via Quadratic Error Function minimization, differing from its sibling by using explicit edge generation and sequential processing.
